item.title: Show HN: I turned the ending of Trainspotting into a tiny web art installation
item.summary: I have always loved the final moments of Trainspotting and Born Slippy! I tried turning them into a small audiovisual experience on the web. Put on headphones and give it a couple of minutes. Comments URL: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=49334291 Points: 2 # Comments: 0
